name: cursor-particle-fountain
title: Cursor Particle Fountain
description: A decorative canvas fountain erupting gravity-bound sparkles as pointer travels rapidly across the surface.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Monospace
Color: Neon On Dark

## Rules

- Pointer Motion Emission: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
